summary: Americas Gold & Silver Corporation filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, announcing high-grade infill drill results from its Cosal Complex. The press release details drill intercepts with silver grades up to 599.8 g/t Ag over 14.0m and 509.7 g/t Ag over 10.0m, highlighting potential grade upgrades versus current Mineral Resource estimates. No corporate event, acquisition, divestiture, or structural change is disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update on drilling results and mine planning. This is not a special-situation filing but a standard current report on exploration progress. No deal terms apply.
